Alternate page changes are recorded without claiming their cause; no scale/pagination retuning.
sanity: All thirty open and end on the initial tonic. All retain dominant-seventh events; frozen display protections preserve short structural seventh/chromatic changes. No duplicate adjacent root/quality events, duplicate offsets, or generated bass nodes. The many protected events in #68 still resemble a voice-leading stream; explicitly flagged rather than claiming the batch is uniformly sparse.
